title: The std datatype catalog
description: Maps the 13 core datatypes to form/validation behavior (work document #37 §3.3). Where a natural JSON Schema exists, one is given; where none exists, the mapping is the explicit marker opaque — no form is rendered, IIP validation is skipped, and UIs may still render non-form affordances. Opaque is a defined outcome, not a gap: non-JSON-able packets generally hit the same path, since validation and forms apply to JSON-able data only. all carries the empty schema: it accepts anything and renders a raw JSON editor.

bang.description: Unit packet — no payload to validate.

buffer.description: Binary; MsgPack bin is not JSON. UIs may render a file picker backed by out-of-band transfer.

stream.description: A delivery shape, not a value shape.
